_note: Holiday Lights guide (/holiday-lights/). Hand-maintained: each display verified on its own official page; record the URL in `source`. Never guess dates: if the organizer hasn't posted this year's dates, set dates2026Confirmed false, leave startDate/endDate empty and describe the usual pattern in `when`. Private home displays only when the display has its own public page and invites visitors; never name homeowners. tier: local (Waynesville/Corwin/Harveysburg/Oregonia/Caesar Creek), county (Warren County and adjacent towns), drive (worth a drive, ~1 hour). The guide is promoted on the home and events pages between season.showFrom and season.showUntil.

items.name: Yuletide Village: Season of Lights
items.location: Renaissance Park, 10542 East State Route 73, Waynesville
items.price: Tickets sold online; check the site for prices
items.about: A walk-through holiday village on the Renaissance Festival grounds, with a "Rivers of Lights" area, a market, carolers, firepits, and Santa and Krampus visits.

items.name: The Christmas Ranch
items.when: Sun–Thu 5–9 pm, Fri–Sat 5–10 pm; closed Thanksgiving Day
items.price: Per carload: online $27–37 depending on date and day (buy by 5 pm the day before); $39 at the gate. Train or wagon rides $4.50 a person, 3 and under free
items.about: Light displays, seven heated shops, a nativity, model trains, and train or wagon rides to Santa's House, just south of Waynesville on Waynesville Road.

items.name: WinterFest at Kings Island
items.location: Kings Island, 6300 Kings Island Drive, Mason
items.when: Select nights; open nights and hours vary, see the park's Calendar & Hours page
items.price: Tickets and season passes sold online; check the site for prices
items.about: The amusement park's holiday event, with light displays, family activities and live entertainment.

items.name: Nights of Lights (Queen City Light Show)
items.location: Warren County Fairgrounds, 665 N. Broadway St., Lebanon
items.price: $30 per carload (up to 8 people) plus $3 fee; online, non-refundable
items.about: A drive-through show of more than 2 million lights with light tunnels and lighted trees. The organizer's ticket page lists the Warren County Fairgrounds as this year's site. No limos, RVs, or vehicles over 22 feet long or 13 feet tall.

items.name: Woodland Lights
items.location: Countryside Park, 895 Miamisburg-Centerville Road, Washington Township
items.when: Nov. 20–22 and 27–29; Dec. 4–6, 11–13 and 18–23; lights only Dec. 26–30; 6–9 pm, gate closes 8:30 pm
items.price: Free; Santa visit $10 per family (registration opens Nov. 1)
items.about: A free walk-through light display run by the Washington Township recreation department.

items.name: Cincinnati Zoo PNC Festival of Lights
items.location: Cincinnati Zoo & Botanical Garden, 3400 Vine St., Cincinnati
items.when: Festival from 4 pm; zoo open until 9 pm Sun–Thu and 10 pm Fri–Sat (10 pm nightly Dec. 20–31). Closed Nov. 26, Dec. 24 and 25
items.price: Included in zoo admission (cheaper online); parking $12
items.about: About 5 million LED lights, a Wild Lights Show on Swan Lake and animal lanterns. The North Polar Express train and carousel cost extra for non-members.

items.name: Clifton Mill Legendary Light Display
items.location: Historic Clifton Mill, 75 Water St., Clifton
items.when: Gates 5 pm; lights 6–9 pm nightly (6–8 pm Dec. 24 and 25). The mill's page lists both Nov. 27 and Nov. 28 as opening night, so check before an early visit
items.price: $15 a person age 4 and up; pay at the gate
items.about: A walk-through light display around a historic mill and the Little Miami River gorge.

items.name: Pyramid Hill Lights
items.location: Pyramid Hill Sculpture Park, 1763 Hamilton Cleves Road, Hamilton
items.price: Tickets sold online; check the site for prices
items.about: A drive-through light show in the sculpture park. Vehicles over 10 feet tall or 20 feet long can't drive the full route.

items.name: A Carillon Christmas
items.location: Carillon Historical Park, 1000 Carillon Blvd., Dayton
items.when: Sun–Thu 5–9 pm, Fri–Sat 5–10 pm; closed Thanksgiving, Christmas Eve and Christmas Day
items.price: Adults $14, seniors $12, ages 3–17 $10, 2 and under free; free parking
items.about: Dayton History's holiday walk through a park campus decorated with thousands of lights, including the Carillon Tree of Light.

items.name: Christmas Glow at Land of Illusion
items.location: Land of Illusion, 8762 Thomas Road, Middletown
items.when: Usually Nov. 20 – Dec. 24, 6–10 pm, plus drive-through only Dec. 26–30
items.price: Tickets sold online; check the site for prices
items.about: A 2-mile drive-through route with eight themed areas, plus a Christmas village with a 45-foot tree, Santa's Workshop and a petting zoo.

items.name: Light Up Middletown
items.when: Usually every night Thanksgiving through New Year's Eve, 6–10 pm, rain or shine
items.about: A volunteer-run drive-through light display in Smith Park.
